quarterly_data.signal: FY2026 (March 2025 - February 2026) annual securities report: net sales JPY 128,794 million (up 3.5% year on year), which the company attributes mainly to higher demand from Taiwanese customers; operating profit JPY 31,154 million (down 2.7%) and ordinary profit JPY 32,621 million (down 8.0%), with SG&A raised by the full-year consolidation of an overseas subsidiary consolidated in the prior year and its goodwill amortisation; net profit attributable to owners JPY 19,048 million (down 19.4%) after a JPY 7,429 million provision for loss on litigation booked as an extraordinary loss. Semiconductor & FPD equipment segment: sales JPY 127,593 million (up 3.5%), segment profit JPY 32,003 million (down 2.9%); life science segment: sales JPY 1,201 million (up 11.8%), segment profit JPY 13 million (down 89.1%).
quarterly_data.figure: FY2026 net sales JPY 128,794 million (+3.5%); operating profit JPY 31,154 million (-2.7%); net profit JPY 19,048 million (-19.4%)

quarterly_data.signal: FY2026 sales by product: semiconductor-related equipment (atmospheric wafer-transfer systems - EFEMs, wafer sorters, N2-purge wafer stockers - vacuum wafer-transfer systems and stand-alone robots, aligners and load ports) JPY 106,345 million (103.9% of the prior year); analysis equipment (automated vapour-phase decomposition systems) JPY 3,554 million (90.1%); FPD-related equipment JPY 6,298 million (73.3%); parts, repair and other JPY 11,395 million (135.3%); life science JPY 1,201 million (111.8%); from this year the company moved part of parts, repair and other into analysis equipment. Sales by customer location: Japan JPY 9,951 million, Taiwan JPY 31,845 million, China JPY 35,767 million, Korea JPY 6,657 million, United States JPY 32,874 million, other regions JPY 11,697 million. Production (at manufacturing cost): semiconductor-related equipment JPY 66,459 million (104.3%), FPD-related equipment JPY 5,387 million (67.6%), total JPY 72,539 million (100.3%).
quarterly_data.figure: semiconductor-related equipment sales JPY 106,345 million (103.9%); China JPY 35,767 million, US JPY 32,874 million, Taiwan JPY 31,845 million

Semiconductor-related equipment: orders JPY 103,971 million (105.2%), backlog JPY 50,461 million (95.5%); analysis equipment: orders JPY 3,204 million (89.8%), backlog JPY 3,196 million (90.1%); FPD-related equipment: orders JPY 5,381 million (71.8%), backlog JPY 1,678 million (64.7%); life science: orders JPY 812 million (118.4%), backlog JPY 71 million.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2026 orders JPY 113,371 million (102.5%); year-end backlog JPY 55,408 million (93.9%); semiconductor-related equipment backlog JPY 50,461 million

quarterly_data.signal: Capacity plan: as announced on October 11, 2024, the Vietnamese subsidiary RORZE ROBOTECH CO.,LTD. (Hai Phong, the group's main semiconductor-equipment plant) plans capital investment of about USD 330 million in total from mid-2025 to 2032 to double its production capacity and automate its production lines, carried out in stages; the first-phase new plant is to start construction in Q1 2027 and is targeted for completion in Q1 2028, with further phases depending on the market. The company states the plant land has been acquired and operation is scheduled to start around spring 2028. FY2026 capex totalled JPY 4,533 million, mainly a multi-storey car park at the head office, a subsidiary's land acquisition and office expansion work.
quarterly_data.figure: about USD 330 million Vietnam capex (mid-2025 to 2032) to double capacity; first new plant completion targeted Q1 2028; FY2026 capex JPY 4,533 million

quarterly_data.signal: Management states the semiconductor market is expected to grow in advanced logic and memory on the spread of generative AI and rising data-center demand, and that the semiconductor equipment market is also expected to expand with AI-related capital investment; in FY2026 investment in advanced logic and memory for AI servers was firm and related investment including advanced packaging was active. Management is concerned that the oil problem from the conflict between the US / Israel and Iran could affect the parts-procurement environment, and responds by strengthening the supply chain and procurement management including ordering parts in advance; at the existing Vietnam plant it is building automated production and AI-based automated inspection. The company targets growth in net sales and ordinary profit.

FY2026 R&D expenses totalled JPY 1,927 million, of which JPY 1,857 million in the semiconductor & FPD equipment segment, where the main new product developed was PLP (panel-level package) compatible equipment, and JPY 70 million in life science.
quarterly_data.figure: R&D JPY 1,927 million; new PLP (panel-level package) compatible equipment

quarterly_data.signal: Patent litigation: Kawasaki Heavy Industries sued Rorze and its US subsidiary RORZE AUTOMATION, Inc. on August 30, 2022 in the US District Court for the Northern District of California, alleging that Rorze products infringe its US patents; on March 13, 2026 the jury returned a verdict for the plaintiff with damages provisionally set at USD 48 million. Rorze booked a JPY 7,429 million provision for loss on litigation and states it will seek review through post-trial motions and appeal.
quarterly_data.figure: jury verdict damages provisionally USD 48 million; provision JPY 7,429 million
